recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆巨大的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）緊密聚集成團，各有豐富淡紫藍色細胞質與大型分葉核，體積遠大於周圍紅血球與顆粒球；一個視野內出現多顆巨核細胞群聚，即巨核細胞增生。
features: Cluster of several large megakaryocytes with abundant granular lavender-blue cytoplasm
Large lobulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Megakaryocytes closely apposed, forming a loose cluster
No micromegakaryocytes or separated hypolobated nuclear forms evident in this field
Background red cells and a few small hematopoietic cells for size comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cluster of several large megakaryocytes with abundant granular lavender cytoplasm and large lobulated nuclei, dwarfing adjacent red cells and myeloid cells. The megakaryocytes appear mature without obvious micromegakaryocytes, widely separated nuclear lobes, or bizarre hyperlobation in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia; clustering may be seen in reactive states such as immune thrombocytopenia but, when prominent, warrants correlation with biopsy, blood counts, and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing for a myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Shows large to giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters with thrombocytosis and a driver mutation.
Megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in dense clusters, with reticulin fibrosis on biopsy.
Dysplastic megakaryocytes are small micromegakaryocytes or have separated round nuclear lobes rather than large mature forms.
Tumor clusters show cohesive cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding, lacking granular megakaryocytic cytoplasm.
